answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 63 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in canyon, queued in tide, and reef publishes the wait time. A farm of 225 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1107 identities would post 1362 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
